name: services/crstests/change_task_node_properties
description:
Changes properties of a TaskNode.
Please note: only properties present in the parameters of this method will be changed (other properties will remain unchanged).

arguments.name: visible_for_students
arguments.description: boolean, if true the results from this node will be visible to students

arguments.name: algorithm
arguments.description: source code of the algorithm used for automatic grading, (see algorithm note)

arguments.name: variables
arguments.description: variables of the algorithm used for automatic grading (see algorithm note)

arguments.name: algorithm_description_pl
arguments.description: description of the algorithm (in polish) used for automatic grading

arguments.name: algorithm_description_en
arguments.description: description of the algorithm (in polish) used for automatic grading

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.description: dependencies of the algorithm used for automatic grading JSON encoded dictionary mapping node IDs to handles. (see algorithm note)

arguments.name: points_precision
arguments.description: integer in range [0, 3], the number of digits after the decimal dot

arguments.name: points_min
arguments.description: minimal number of points for a task, should be less or equal to 0, only permitted for task node

arguments.name: points_max
arguments.description: maximal number of points for a task, should be greater than 0, only permitted for task node

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: Currently, this method always returns the same value: a dictionary with single success key with value of true.
